method: Whole-file reading of4files; bytes matched pinned Git objects. No PowerShell script or Windows localization execution.
findings: Format Sources accepts Path parameter but enumerates ProjectRoot two levels above script, recursively rewriting cpp/h/ps1 to UTF8BOM/CRLF, trimming trailing whitespace/blank excess. Writes only changed bytes, reducing timestamp churn. No script executed.

Compress Strings sorts/deduplicates and rewrites language sources, excludes MSI keys from combined runtime resource, generates LangStrings.h only on hash change and invokes makecab LZX. No explicit LASTEXITCODE failure check after makecab visible.

Language enumeration and sorting do not specify explicit ordinal/culture order; identical normalized resource bytes across environments not proved. Source formatting/translation packaging are checkout mutations during prebuild, not only generated-output writes.

Localization.LoadResource overlays English baseline then external specific/generic or built-in specific/generic translation, sets RTL. Global map is not cleared here, so keys absent in later English/selected language can retain prior map entries; actual installed translation behavior not exercised.

CrackStrings strips carriage returns, expands literal backslash-n/t, splits first equals and last duplicate key assignment wins. With prefix it checks prefix occurrence before starts-with filtering. Return value tests global map nonempty, not necessarily newly loaded keys.

UTF8conversion uses MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS and two-pass sizing. External language file is read in full without explicit byte budget, with size narrowed to int for conversion; huge-file behavior unqualified.

Localization.Format catches format_error and returns untranslated format string rather than terminate on malformed user-editable formatting. Menu/control/tab updating and RTL styling read only; no rendered validation.
limits: No build, cabinet compression, source rewriting, Windows UTF8 API, localization switch or UI execution.
Language catalog contents/assets still require their own declared review method; reading loader does not count catalogs.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
